author: Tunahan Ali Ozturk
name: OrionGuard minimal API with the EF Core outbox
description: The OrionGuard minimal API plus EF Core: an aggregate raises a domain event, SaveChanges writes it to the transactional outbox in the same transaction, and the dispatcher hosted service delivers it.

database.description: The EF Core provider the outbox and the aggregate are stored with.

choices.description: SQLite. Runs with no server, so the generated project starts as-is.
